mutation_targets.rationale: F_AuthRequired is the only fact tying outcome=OK to caller presence. Clearing it and forcing a successful but uncalled operation gives a direct counterexample to FR-001.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthBypass { some op: Operation | op.outcome = OK and no op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_AppendOnlyDeletionLog is the sole guard against two TaskDeletion rows for the same task. Clearing it and forcing duplicates exposes any model that secretly allowed re-deletion.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateDeletion { some disj td1, td2: TaskDeletion | td1.deletedTask = td2.deletedTask }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_DeletionLogPerDelete is the load-bearing fact for one-TaskDeletion-per-successful-DeleteOp. Injecting a successful DeleteOp with no matching log row breaks audit completeness.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingDeletionLog { some op: Operation | op.kind = DeleteOp and op.outcome = OK and (no td: TaskDeletion | td.recordedFor = op) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Same fact also pins TaskDeletion.deletedBy to the operation's caller. Injecting a misattributed entry exposes any predicate that doesn't actually check attribution.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_Misattribution { some td: TaskDeletion | td.deletedBy != td.recordedFor.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_ClosedTaskRule encodes the FR-011 reopen-or-fail invariant. Injecting an OK edit of a Done task that does not set status to Todo/InProgress directly contradicts FR-011.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ClosedEditAllowed { some op: Operation | op.kind = EditOp and op.outcome = OK and some op.target and op.target.status = Done and no op.setsStatus }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_NoSideEffectsOnFailure forbids producing a newTask when the operation failed. Injecting a ValidationFail CreateOp that nonetheless carries a newTask is the canonical 'side effect on failure' counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_FailedCreateSideEffect { some op: Operation | op.kind = CreateOp and op.outcome = ValidationFail and some op.newTask }
